decisions.decision: Adapt the supplied amulet-invite-studio editor architecture into the existing React 18 application with scoped CSS, a compact white rail/sidebar, real device frames, and a draggable bottom sheet on phones.
Keep one normalized invitation draft as the source of truth for content, typography, colors, buttons, gallery, RSVP configuration, music, undo/redo, private preview, and checkout.
Save through the private preview API and route every Buy action through the existing promo validation, Stripe checkout, and post-payment publication flow.
